# ADR-0007: Extend idempotency retention to 48 hours

Status: Accepted
Date: 2025-06-02
Deciders: Lena Hargrove, Priya Natarajan
Amends: ADR-0004 (rule 3 only)
Governs: services/payments/idempotency.py

## Context

After the 17 May processor outage, card-network retries arrived up to ~40 hours
after the original request. With a 24-hour window, those retries were treated as
new payments.

## Decision

Idempotency records are kept and replayed for 48 hours instead of 24. All other
rules in ADR-0004 are unchanged.

## Consequences

Roughly double the Redis memory for `idem:*` keys.
